ignoreExports.$comment: Root-level vitest infrastructure is outside fallow's `entry` graph, so `server` and `MOCK_API_BASE_URL` read as unused and `fallow fix` strips the `export` keyword. They are consumed by vitest.setup.ts, apps/expo/vitest.config.ts, and the *.unit.test.ts files that call `server.use()`.

The /master-design component catalog is reachable only through a dev-only, lazily code-split TanStack route (gated by `import.meta.env.DEV`), so fallow's static `entry` graph treats its modules as unused and `fallow fix` strips their `export` keywords. It is a real route rendered at /master-design in development.

next-intl plugin entry (`createNextIntlPlugin("./src/core/utils/i18n.ts")`). The default export is loaded by path, not imported, so fallow's graph treats it as unused. `formats` is a real import from env.d.ts.

overrides.$comment: `fallow security` ignores rule severities from `rules`/`overrides` entirely (verified: setting security-sink/security-client-server-leak to off changes nothing). Its findings are suppressed only by in-source tokens — `// fallow-ignore-file security-client-server-leak` and `// fallow-ignore-next-line security-sink`. See apps/web/src/**/*.client.tsx and components/ui/chart.tsx.

Root-level tool configs and service-worker entries: nothing imports them (their own CLI or the browser loads them), so they sit outside fallow's `entry` graph and read as unused files. `stryker.config.mjs` is loaded by the `stryker` binary — see docs/adr/0003-mutation-testing-is-advisory.md. `scripts/security/*` are CI entry points invoked by node/bun from workflows / package.json scripts (not imported).

Loaded by path from the `setupFiles` arrays in packages/core/vitest.config.ts and apps/expo/vitest.config.ts, so no import edge reaches it and it reads as unreachable. See docs/adr/0002-network-boundary-mocking-with-msw.md.

duplicates.$comment: spa and web are deliberate mirrors for browser-only code that cannot move into @workspace/core (core must stay browser + expo/native safe). Ignoring one side of each mirrored pair drops the whole clone group from duplication analysis while leaving complexity, coupling and hotspot analysis intact.

thresholdOverrides.reason: Inline OG SVG markup is declarative length, not control-flow complexity
